facts.text: Established in 1964, the Brown-Tougaloo Partnership was the nation's first exchange between an HBCU and an Ivy League institution, allowing qualified Tougaloo students to spend a semester or year at Brown.

sources.title: Brown-Tougaloo Partnership Programs | Tougaloo College
sources.quote: The formal partnership between Tougaloo College and Brown University was established, creating the first exchange program between an HBCU and an Ivy League institution during the height of the Civil Rights Movement.

sources.title: Brown-Tougaloo Partnership Programs | Tougaloo College
sources.quote: Qualified Tougaloo students spend a semester or academic year at Brown University, experiencing Ivy League academics while maintaining their Tougaloo enrollment.
